findings.summary: Guard redirect() runs inside Suspense after the shell streams, so non-admins get HTTP 200 plus client-side redirect, not a 307. No admin content leaks (fallback null) but guard is not enforced at proxy/HTTP-status level; future admin data must stay behind the same per-request check
Broad try/catch wraps connection(); Next docs advise not catching dynamic-API signals. Build and e2e pass, so currently benign; narrow the try to the supabase calls
Admin role is based solely on app_metadata.role string; no audit or role-source doc beyond permissions.md. Acceptable for placeholder route, revisit when real admin features land
When remaining is an exact multiple of 60s the timer fires after 1ms (one extra immediate tick); harmless, no leak, cleared on unmount
